verdicts.reason: Both are broken the same way. The background panels (peach block and pasta-pattern texture) have been shrunk into tiny thumbnails holding postage-stamp-sized food photos. The decorative frame is an empty, detached rectangle beside a floating plate illustration, so the hero imagery is effectively gone and the middle reads as debris. A is marginally better because its 'Cascadia' wordmark keeps proper weight over RESTAURANT; in B the brand name shrinks to near-caption size, which weakens the brand further.
